mug = obs["objects"]["yellow_mug"]
cyan_tray = obs["zones"]["cyan_tray"]

    # Clear cyan_tray by moving all objects to free spots
    for obj_name in cyan_tray["occupants"]:
        obj = obs["objects"][obj_name]
        free_spots_list = free_spots("cyan_tray", obj_name)
        if free_spots_list["spots"]:
            spot = free_spots_list["spots"][0]
            carry_to(spot["x"], spot["y"], height=0.18, yaw=spot["gripper_yaw"])

            open_gripper()
            retreat()

task_spec.refined_instruction: First, move the yellow_mug from the orange_tray to the cyan_tray. Before doing so, confirm that the cyan_tray is unoccupied; if not, clear it first. Then, move the blue_book from its current location (not on any zone) to the orange_tray. Before placing it, confirm that the orange_tray is now unoccupied (after the yellow_mug has been moved). After each placement, verify that the object is correctly positioned on its target zone. Success is achieved when both the yellow_mug is on the cyan_tray and the blue_book is on the orange_tray, with no other objects on those zones.
